changes: Original bare token no longer activates the app; validated account/token/expiry metadata binds every private request. Original unbound token and queue keys are retained and never upgraded or replayed.

MainActor request revision and exact session snapshot fence every asynchronous network result. Expired context and authoritative 401 clear private UI; response from old account cannot populate current views. Public catalog sends no bearer; API routes remain below original HTTPS base. Ephemeral transport refuses redirects rather than forwarding private wire body.
Keychain writes update existing values atomically before adding a new key; no delete-before-add loss of the original record on write failure.

Persist the original account-bound mutation body/key before dispatch. Restart or explicit retry retains exact wire bytes/key; changed content cannot replace unknown result. Confirmation removes only exact original envelope; invalid data remains for recovery.

Logout creates local negative authority and binds cancellation to the original pending digest. Callback requires its original active pending marker and cannot reactivate a cancelled request, including after restart. This is local cancellation, not server revoke.

UI sign-out clears private records, recipient/deletion fields and owned temporary export; sign_out uses all 12 inherited translations. Account change resets views and private draft state. Privacy deletion blocks account-bound unresolved mutations.

AppKit opener and portable input/title modifiers prepare the shared source for macOS. Payment check now reads original GET orders/{id}/settlement and refreshes actual server orders instead of inventing a transition.

macOSCore.command: swiftc -parse-as-library -emit-module Security.swift API.swift ShopModel.swift WalletAuth.swift -module-name YNXShopCore
macOSCore.scope: Actual production core, conditional AppKit implementation and MainActor model compiled with installed macOS toolchain; no UI app or release package is implied.

foundationBoundaries.scope: Actual API/queue/session/cancellation/redirect code, controlled URLProtocol and memory storage. No actual Keychain record, Wallet, hardware key or network authority was changed.

fullSwiftUIApp.reason: Installed Command Line Tools SDK references absent SwiftUIMacros.StateMacro plugin. Raw final failure log retained. Full Xcode unavailable; no full app build or installed macOS/iOS acceptance.

verification.legacyAuth: Inherited WalletAuth exchange and bearer compatibility remain; not a canonical Native Product Session SDK consumer.
